text.en:
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 474 October 26, 1976
CREATING THE AGENCY FOR THE DEVELOPMENT AND WELFARE OF MUSLIMS IN THE
PHILIPPINES
WHEREAS, the Philippine Government has long exerted efforts to uplift the living conditions of Muslim
Filipinos as part of the over-all program of national development;
WHEREAS, the Islamic Conference, an organization of Islamic nations throughout the world, has expressed
admiration and appreciation for efforts of the Philippine Government and has offered to assist in these efforts;
WHEREAS, the Philippine Government welcomes such assistance and believes that maximum benefit can be
obtained from it if handled by one agency exclusively changed to do so;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution, do hereby create the Agency for the Development and Welfare of Muslims
in the Philippines to be given primary responsibility for the disposition of any assistance extended by the
Islamic Conference for the benefit of Filipino Muslims.
Ambassador Lininding P. Pangandaman, Assistant Secretary for Islamic Affairs
Vice Chairman
Dr. Cesar A. Majul, Chairman, Philippine Amanah Bank
Commissioner Romulo Espaldon Region IX
Commissioner Simeon Datumanong Region XII
The Agency for the Development and Welfare of Muslims in the Philippines shall be charged with the
following duties and responsibilities:
1. Identify priority areas for the application of assistance from the Islamic Conference.
2. Inform Islamic Conference, through the Department of Foreign Affairs, of these priority areas and the type
and extent of assistance needed.
3. Coordinate the mobilization of in-country resources needed for the priority areas identified.
4. Utilize the assistance extended by the Islamic Conference in the priority areas identified, including victims
of natural conditions.
5. Monitor the progress of work in these priority areas.
6. Inform the Islamic Conference, through the Department of Foreign Affairs, of the status of relief and
development efforts in these priority areas.
The Office of Islamic Affairs in the Department of Foreign Affairs shall serve as the secretariat of this
The Agency may call upon any and all other agencies of the Government for assistance in the implementation
of its duties and responsibilities.
Executive Order No. 432 dated August 30, 1974, is hereby repealed and the Filpino Muslim Welfare and
Relief Agency abolished, and the records and files transferred to the Agency for the Development and Welfare
of Muslims in the Philippines.
Done in the City of Manila, this 26th day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
